summary: John's 1st cousin 7x removed; wife of John Pringle.
bio:
Phoebe Davenport (1799 - after 1873) married John Pringle; nine children (see John Pringle). Will: Plymouth, 1867, vol. D p.344.

Giles & Franklin give Phoebe's birth as 4 May 1799, daughter of Thomas and Charity (Lamoreux) Davenport, and say she married John Pringle (H0155). Their nine children: Thomas (b. 1821), Dennison (b. 1830), Clara (m. Sam Shaffer; d. aged 94), Charity (b. 1832; m. 1855 Andrew Worthington), William, Betsy (d. unmarried), Lydia, Martha (m. ___ Weaver) and Stephen ([R4-S1]). The censuses agree. In 1850 she was 52, in John's household with Thomas, Clarissa, Elizabeth, Lydia, William, Denison, Charity and Martha. In 1860 she was a 62-year-old widow keeping house with the unmarried Elizabeth (Betsy) and Lydia ([R4-S2]). Her will was proved in 1867.
sources: Giles & Franklin, Thomas Davenport, Philipstown Pioneer 1682-1759, and his Descendants (1962): https://archive.org/details/thomasdavenportp00gile (also HathiTrust wu.89066038563: https://babel.hathitrust.org/cgi/pt?id=wu.89066038563&view=1up&seq=395) pp.321-322
[R4-S1] Giles & Franklin, Thomas Davenport ... and his Descendants (1962), p.321 (secondary) https://archive.org/details/thomasdavenportp00gile

conflicts.found: FS KP7J-PJ2 attaches 'Phebe Davenport' as a child of Samuel Pringle and Martha Lamoreaux
conflicts.assessment: FS is wrong. She was Samuel's daughter-in-law (wife of his probable son John), not his daughter. Her maiden name Davenport and Giles & Franklin both show this.
